title: Klippo Prebuilt Complete Prompt Catalog
source: Pre-rendered complete prompts from current subcategory variations and existing eight presets.

presets.cinematic: Realistic cinematic commercial, controlled soft light, natural shadows, one smooth motivated camera move.
presets.minimal: Clean studio, balanced soft light, negative space, restrained product-focused movement.
presets.lifestyle: Believable everyday setting, natural light, realistic product interaction.
presets.dynamic: Strong opening, energetic controlled pacing, one clear action, clean cuts.
presets.luxury: Premium lighting, refined contrast, controlled highlights, elegant framing.
presets.flatlay: Tasteful overhead or angled flat lay, deliberate spacing, soft shadows.
presets.creative_reveal: Reveal through framing, focus, light or camera movement; never transform the product.
presets.white_doodle: Thin white 2D doodles trace only visible product contours/details; never obscure the item or add captions.

prompt_variants.10:
VIDEO PROMPT — 10s | 9:16
PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Cinematic product commercial with a motivated, fluid camera move and natural depth.
MODEL: No human or animal model. Use only the display arrangement supported by the reference; do not invent a hanger, mannequin, accessories or extra pieces.
SCENE: Clean athletic studio with crisp light and controlled contrast. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–2s Open at a low angle, then rise to show the activewear item's complete shape. 2–6s Track across visible seams, panels or mesh only where present; keep construction unchanged. 6–8s Finish with a stable full-product frame readable at phone size. 8–10s Finish with a full-product hero frame: activewear silhouette, complete and unobstructed. Use a continuous, motivated camera move and let the product detail emerge naturally.
CAMERA: One smooth dolly or shallow arc; preserve perspective and garment proportions.
LIGHTING: Soft directional key light, gentle fill and natural shadows; retain source colours.
AUDIO: Restrained instrumental music below any selected voice; fabric rustle only when visibly caused. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
PRODUCT FIDELITY: The supplied reference is the source of truth. Preserve all visible cut, construction, colour, print, texture, labels and proportions. Invent no features, claims, accessories, logos or text.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Energetic but polished commercial pacing built around one readable visual action.
MODEL: One adult human model may wear or present the activewear naturally. Use only a controlled stance shift or small step, not a workout demonstration; preserve fit, panels, print and colour and invent no performance claims.
SCENE: Energetic framing with stable motion and realistic proportions. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.

LIGHTING: Crisp directional light with controlled contrast and no clipped garment detail.
AUDIO: Rhythmic instrumental music below any selected voice; no unmotivated impact sounds. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
CONTINUITY: One continuous 2-part film. Match garment identity, scale, position, background, light direction, colour balance and motion direction across clips. No jumps, morphing, duplicates or sudden scene changes.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Cinematic product commercial with a motivated, fluid camera move and natural depth.
MODEL: One adult human model may wear or present the activewear naturally. Use only a controlled stance shift or small step, not a workout demonstration; preserve fit, panels, print and colour and invent no performance claims.
SCENE: Accurate white balance and simple colour contrast, not neon effects. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–4s Frame the item against a plain background that complements its existing colours without adding patterns. 4–13s Slide across existing colour panels or print, keeping their boundaries fixed. 13–23s Pull back to show the full item against the clean background. 23–30s Finish with a clean, steady hero frame: colour-block pass. Use a continuous, motivated camera move and let the product detail emerge naturally.
CAMERA: One smooth dolly or shallow arc; preserve perspective and garment proportions.
LIGHTING: Soft directional key light, gentle fill and natural shadows; retain source colours.
AUDIO: Restrained instrumental music below any selected voice; fabric rustle only when visibly caused. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
PRODUCT FIDELITY: The supplied reference is the source of truth. Preserve all visible cut, construction, colour, print, texture, labels and proportions. Invent no features, claims, accessories, logos or text.
